capabilities: Generate quiz questions from the current note with an LLM
Use OpenAI models (gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini) or local Ollama models
Send generated questions to the Spaced Repetition plugin
Optionally limit the number of generated questions
Run via ribbon icon, command, or custom hotkey
disambiguation: Not a manual flashcard editor; it uses an LLM to generate quiz questions from an existing note rather than helping you write cards yourself.
extras: For local Ollama use, the README warns about a CORS issue and gives terminal commands to set OLLAMA_ORIGINS on mac/linux and Windows. The README has a marketing tone but covers setup and usage for both OpenAI and local models.
problem: Writing flashcards and quiz questions by hand from notes is slow, and Obsidian has no built-in way to generate them automatically.

relations.evidence: Generate quizzes that seamlessly integrate with the Spaced Repetition Obsidian plugin.
Inspired by the code architecture of the obsidian-textgenerator-plugin.

summary: LLM-powered quiz generator that turns a note into flashcard questions for use with the Spaced Repetition plugin.
